segments.an6.23:2.2: Kāmarāgarattāyaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgavinibaddho diṭṭhadhammikāpi bhayā na parimuccati, samparāyikāpi bhayā na parimuccati, tasmā ‘bhayan’ti kāmānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
segments.an6.23:2.3: Kasmā ca, bhikkhave, dukkhanti … pe … rogoti … gaṇḍoti … saṅgoti … paṅkoti kāmānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ?
segments.an6.23:2.8: Kāmarāgarattāyaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgavinibaddho diṭṭhadhammikāpi paṅkā na parimuccati, samparāyikāpi paṅkā na parimuccati, tasmā ‘paṅko’ti kāmānametaṃ adhivacanan”ti.
segments.an6.23:3.1: “Bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ rogo gaṇḍo, saṅgo paṅko ca ubhayaṃ;
segments.an6.23:3.3: Ete kāmā pavuccanti, yattha satto puthujjano.

lines: Saṅgo paṅko ca ubhayanti saṅgo ca paṅko ca idampi ubhayaṃ.
Ete kāmā pavuccanti, yattha satto puthujjanoti yasmiṃ saṅge ca paṅke ca puthujjano satto laggo laggito palibuddho.
Jātimaraṇasambhaveti jātiyā ca maraṇassa ca sambhave paccayabhūte.
Jātimaraṇasaṅkhayeti jātimaraṇānaṃ saṅkhayasaṅkhāte nibbāne, nibbānārammaṇāya vimuttiyā vimuccantīti attho.
Imasmiṃ ṭhāne vivaṭṭetvā arahattameva patto esa bhikkhu.
Imasmiṃ sutte vaṭṭameva kathetvā gāthāsu vaṭṭavivaṭaṃ kathitaṃ.

lines: Tatiye sambhavati jātimaraṇaṃ etenāti sambhavo, upādānanti āha “jātiyā ca maraṇassa ca sambhave paccayabhūte”ti.
Jātimaraṇāni sammā khīyanti etthāti jātimaraṇasaṅkhayo, nibbānanti āha “jātimaraṇānaṃ saṅkhayasaṅkhāte nibbāne”ti.
Sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagunti sakalampi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ atikkantā carimacittanirodhena vaṭṭadukkhalesassapi asambhavato.
